title: LD24 Bulkhead Hoist/Service Crane Replacement
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION MISSISSIPPI VALLEY.ENDIST ST LOUIS.W07V ENDIST ST LOUIS
description_text: The work will consist of furnishing all labor, equipment, operators, supervision, supplies, materials, and incidentals necessary to supply and install the replacement Lock and Dam 24 Bulkhead Hoist /Service Crane. The installation work is anticipated to be accomplished with traditional river marine construction equipment such as floating plant, barge mounted crane, and additional support equipment as needed. --------- AMENDMENT 0001 to provide revised SOW, Appendix C and Government Responses to ProjNet Bidder Inquiries.
